subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline rendering read absolute MEDIA paths from the host process, or should it render only trusted structured image blocks and media-store references?
rationale: The feature crosses from model/tool text into local host file reads and terminal graphics output, which is a product and security boundary choice automation should not make implicitly.

options.title: Render trusted structured media only
options.body: Require the implementation to consume current image blocks or generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

options.title: Allow constrained absolute MEDIA reads
options.body: Keep host path reads only if maintainers explicitly define trusted roots, tests, and live proof across local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause under the canonical tracker
options.body: Keep the feature tracked in the canonical issue while this stale draft is rebased or replaced by a sponsored implementation.

recommendation.title: Render trusted structured media only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to consume current image blocks or generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

likelyOwner.reason: The TUI kit and image_generate history make this the best available owner signal for the product/security boundary choice.
